What you'll find here

Short episodes. Real conversations.

Cold showers and 5am alarms don't fix a dysregulated nervous system. The men who change most aren't the ones who grind harder — they're the ones who regulate better.

The Reset is a daily podcast for driven dads. Each episode covers nervous system regulation, presence, fatherhood, business, health, AI, tech, and the intersections of these topics with real life. No fluff. No three-hour episodes. Just clarity under pressure.
